description: This file contains an immutable implementation of the ReplyTarget interface, including JSON serialization/deserialization, builder pattern, and internal data handling for reply target configuration within a connectivity model.

classes.name: ImmutableReplyTarget
classes.description: An immutable implementation of the ReplyTarget interface with JSON serialization support.

classes.name: ImmutableReplyTarget.Builder
classes.description: Builder class for ImmutableReplyTarget, following the builder pattern for object creation.

methods.name: getAddress
methods.description: Returns the address string of the reply target.

methods.name: getHeaderMapping
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the header mapping if present.

methods.name: getExpectedResponseTypes
methods.description: Returns the set of expected response types.

methods.name: toBuilder
methods.description: Returns a builder pre-populated with the current object's data.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes this reply target to a JSON object with schema version and predicate filtering.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates an ImmutableReplyTarget from a JSON object, throws if required fields are missing.

methods.name: fromJsonOptional
methods.description: Creates an Optional of ReplyTarget from JSON, returning empty if JSON is invalid or incomplete.
